learnings: Added FavoritesProviderTests.cs in MtgDeckInfoScraper.Tests/Unit/ with 6 tests covering: GetFavoritesAsync returns empty list when storage is null, AddFavoriteAsync persists a new deck, AddFavoriteAsync is idempotent (no duplicates on double add), RemoveFavoriteAsync removes only the targeted deck by Id, IsFavoriteAsync returns true for stored deck and false for unknown Id.
Used Moq to mock ILocalStorageAccessor. All 9 unit tests pass (dotnet build exit 0, dotnet test --filter Unit exit 0).
